# tribe.jivamuktiyoga.com
#
# Hand-authored. build-web.js copies src/static/** to the web root verbatim and leaves a
# hand-authored robots.txt alone. sitemap.xml and llms.txt next to it are generated by
# launch/seo/build-seo.py.
#
# about-tribe.html is hidden at the client's request (30 Sep 2026) while its copy is reworked.
#
# The review pages below also carry <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> (about-tribe.html: noindex, follow).
# Note the trade-off: a crawler that obeys Disallow never fetches those pages, so it never
# reads their noindex either; a URL linked from elsewhere could still be listed without a
# snippet. Nothing public links to them, so the Disallow lines stay (owner's call).

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /changes.html
Disallow: /social-pack.html
Disallow: /announcement.html
Disallow: /full.html
Disallow: /styleguide.html
Disallow: /styleguide-project.html
Disallow: /about-tribe.html

# ── AI assistants and answer engines ────────────────────────────────────
# Allowed on purpose: people ask assistants about yoga events, and the answer should come
# from this site (dates, venue, prices, line-up). Listed one by one so the policy is explicit
# and any single crawler is a one-line change. Each group repeats the review-page rules,
# because a crawler that finds its own group ignores the * group.

User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Applebot
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: Amazonbot
User-agent: meta-externalagent
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: cohere-ai
User-agent: DuckAssistBot
User-agent: MistralAI-User
Allow: /
Disallow: /changes.html
Disallow: /social-pack.html
Disallow: /announcement.html
Disallow: /full.html
Disallow: /styleguide.html
Disallow: /styleguide-project.html
Disallow: /about-tribe.html
